meta.note: DQSS scores are withheld. The 50 stations previously served here were hand-authored demo values, not DQSS pipeline output — they carried no sub-scores and no computed_at, yet the UI rendered them as grades and used them to drive station marker opacity. Publishing an unlabelled number that a reader cannot distinguish from a measurement is the failure this file now avoids; opacity in particular is a non-verbal encoding that cannot be labelled as a demo. Withheld until models/pipeline/predict_grid.py --dqss publishes real component scores to the HF live dataset (aq-data/data_quality.json). Set source to "measured" only when every component is measured; use "partial" with a meta.inputs breakdown while some components remain unmeasured.
